name: PRAN Group
h1: New factories, new sectors, one view of the work
lede: PRAN-RFL is reviving mills, building solar capacity and expanding export footwear and luggage. Airtable gives operations, procurement and project teams one connected place to run that growth.
why_p: Four expansion moves in 2026, each adding sites, suppliers and projects to coordinate.

signals.title: Solar equipment and 100 per cent solar by FY28
signals.body: PRAN-RFL began work on a solar inverter plant at Palash, plans a second facility in Habiganj and aims to lift its own solar generation from 40MW to 100MW by end-2026.
signals.angle: Multi-site build programmes need one tracker for milestones, suppliers and approvals.

signals.title: Two state jute mills taken over
signals.body: PRAN-RFL signed leases with Bangladesh Jute Mills Corporation for National Jute Mills in Sirajganj and Star Jute Mills in Khulna.
signals.angle: Bringing idle sites back online is a repeatable playbook that Airtable can turn into a shared template.

signals.title: Mango season with 12,000 contract farmers
signals.body: PRAN opened its mango collection season in Rajshahi, targeting 60,000 tonnes from 12,000 contract farmers across ten districts.
signals.angle: Seasonal supplier management across districts and pulping sites fits a connected supplier and intake base.

signals.title: Export footwear and luggage scale-up
signals.body: PRAN-RFL revived three idle Rajshahi factories for export footwear, luggage, tents and umbrellas, targeting 1.5 crore pairs a month within three years.
signals.angle: Order, capacity and procurement visibility across sites helps teams act on supply delays early.
